scope: One source reference sheet split into three enhanced reference pages; not runtime sprites
qa_method: Visual review of full original and all generated pages, native DMI Description inspection, exact state-name comparison to all page labels, visual item/group counts and orientations, PNG decode/size/hash inspection. Each scale cluster, egg-sac cluster, chain coil, and bone group counts as one source-state item.
qa_limits: Reference artwork only; no native-runtime claims.
Output pages are opaque RGB and have different dimensions, spacing, silhouettes, and typography scale than preview/native source.
Native pixel registration, source alpha, palette limits and DMI metadata are not preserved.
Individual pixels and exact subcomponent shapes within clusters are not verified as identical; visual identity and complete state/group coverage are verified.
All work used built-in imagegen; no scripted raster crop or artistic enhancement, no paid API.
Source files read only and not overwritten. Root shared manifest not edited.
